About the role:

We're seeking a Senior PV Performance Engineer to support a growing portfolio of utility-scale and distributed solar assets across the United States.

This role combines solar performance engineering, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision making to optimize plant performance, identify energy losses, and improve operational efficiency across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze operational and SCADA data from solar PV plants.
  • Evaluate plant performance against expected energy production.
  • Develop performance models and predictive analytics solutions.
  • Identify energy losses, equipment issues, and underperformance drivers.
  • Calculate key performance metrics including PR, availability, and energy performance indicators.
  • Collaborate with Asset Management, O&M, Data Science, and Software teams.
  • Support automation of reporting and analytics using modern programming tools and AI-enabled workflows.

Must-have Skills 

  • 5+ years of experience in solar PV performance engineering, asset management, or performance analytics.
  • Strong experience with PVsyst and photovoltaic performance modeling.
  • Experience analyzing SCADA and time-series operational data.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills.
  • Knowledge of solar plant KPIs, energy losses, and performance testing.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics platforms.
  • Strong understanding of PV systems, inverters, trackers, and solar operations.

Nice-to-have:

  • AI Tooling Proficiency: Leverage one or more AI tools to optimize and augment day-to-day work, including drafting, analysis, research, or process automation. Provide recommendations on effective AI use and identify opportunities to streamline workflows.
  • pvlib, NREL SAM.
  • Machine Learning.
  • AWS or Azure.
  • ASTM / IEC performance testing.
  • CMMS platforms such as Fiix, Maximo, or Sitetracker
  • PMP certification
